status: registered before any evaluation of these hypotheses on any data
purpose: Three independently defined XAUUSD intraday hypotheses with wider, volatility-adjusted stops. Research only; no orders.

common.execution_frame: 1m bid OHLC built from MetaQuotes-Demo ticks; fills at the next 1m open; spread by New York hour profile
common.swap: verified symbol_info: long -12.6, short -4.6 USD per lot per night, triple Wednesday

H1_compression_expansion.rationale: Volatility clusters: after an abnormally quiet period, a range break tends to be followed by a volatility expansion that can travel several ATR before mean reversion; a wide volatility stop survives the noisy retest.

rules.compression: ATR14(5m) / ATR100(5m) <= 0.75 at the last completed 5m bar
rules.box: highest high and lowest low of the last 12 completed 5m bars; width <= 2.0 x ATR100(5m)
rules.trigger: first 1m close above box_high + 0.10 x ATR14(5m) (long) or below box_low - 0.10 x ATR14(5m) (short)
rules.filter: 1h EMA50 slope over 3 bars not opposite to the breakout

H2_trend_pullback_continuation.rationale: Persistent intraday trends (institutional flow) pause in shallow retracements; entering when price resumes after a bounded 38-62% retracement of a measured impulse buys continuation at a better price than a breakout.

rules.trend: 1h close > EMA50(1h) with EMA50 rising over 3 bars, and 4h close > EMA50(4h) (long; mirrored for short)
rules.impulse: within the last 12 completed 15m bars the lowest low precedes the highest high and (high - low) >= 2.5 x ATR14(15m)
rules.pullback: the last completed 5m low lies between the 38.2% and 61.8% retracement of that impulse and the 5m close is above the 61.8% level
rules.trigger: first 5m close above the highest high of the previous 3 completed 5m bars

H2_trend_pullback_continuation.difference_from_rejected_B: B entered on 1m triggers after an EMA touch with a 1h direction only; H2 requires a measured impulse leg, a Fibonacci-bounded retracement, 4h agreement, a 5m trigger and wider ATR stops.

H3_liquidity_sweep_displacement.rationale: Stops cluster beyond the Asian-session range; a sweep of that liquidity that immediately fails and is followed by a strong opposite displacement candle indicates absorption and a likely reversal into the range.

rules.levels: Asian range = high/low of 1m bars 00:00-06:59 UTC of the same UTC day
rules.sweep: a completed 5m bar with high > Asian high + 0.10 x ATR14(5m) and close < Asian high (short setup; mirrored for long)
rules.displacement: within the next 3 completed 5m bars, a bearish 5m bar with (open - close) >= 1.0 x ATR14(5m) closing below the sweep bar's low
rules.stop: the farther of (sweep extreme + 0.10 x ATR14(5m)) and (entry + m x ATR14(5m))
rules.frequency: at most one setup per side per UTC day

H3_liquidity_sweep_displacement.difference_from_phase2_liquidity_sweep_m: Phase 2 used 15m fractal swings; H3 uses the Asian-range liquidity pool, a 5m displacement body filter and volatility-adjusted stops.
H3_liquidity_sweep_displacement.timeframes: session levels (1m) -> 5m sweep and displacement -> 1m execution

development.selection_rule: per hypothesis, choose the stop multiple with the highest mean net R on dev_2025_2026 at base costs among variants with >= 100 trades; no other parameter is chosen or changed
development.gate_to_validation: the selected variant needs mean net R > 0 on dev_2025_2026 at base costs AND >= 0 at stress costs AND > 0 on dev_2019_2020 at base costs; otherwise the hypothesis is rejected without validation
development.random_controls: 5 matched random seeds per selected variant (diagnostic)

sources: MT5 terminal local M1 cache 2004-2018 (unexamined; readable only after raising Max bars in chart = terminal restart = operator approval; no tick spreads exist for that period, so the stress spread profile p90 of 2019-2020 is used for both cost scenarios)
prospective shadow forward test of frozen rules (operator approval to launch)
criteria_all_required: mean net R > 0 with Bonferroni-adjusted (m = number of hypotheses entering validation) bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
mean net R above at least 18 of 20 matched random controls
positive net result in >= 2/3 of calendar years (historical) or >= 2 of the last 3 two-month blocks (forward)
validation.outcome: pass = eligible for a pre-registered shadow forward test and, later, the demo execution trial gate; anything else = rejected
